name: M. K. Proteins Limited
summary: M. K. Proteins Limited produces and trades refined vegetable oils and derivatives, including rice bran, sunflower, cottonseed, soybean, palm and canola oils. It also sells by-products such as rice bran fatty acid oils, waxes, gums and spent earth, and imports and trades edible and non-edible oils. Founded in 2012, it is headquartered in Ambala.
